$comment: Gate-3 auto-validation requirements, read by scripts/gate3-validate.mjs.
templates: the sections/pages every FFC-EX site built from each FFC template must ship.
homeSectionIds are element ids rendered unconditionally on the template's home page
(sections that self-hide per site config - programs, endowment, FAQ, team, events,
results, testimonials - are deliberately NOT required). pages are the footer policy
routes both templates ship (footer 'Policy links' nav); each must answer HTTP 200.
repo/repoAliases match the FFC-EX repo's GitHub template_repository; detectSectionIds
is the fallback heuristic when the repo was not generated from a template.
headerNavRequired: the 375px check demands a usable header menu (the footer-only
layout ships no header, so its footer links are the navigation).
consoleAllowlist: the ONLY way to ignore a browser console error. Each entry needs a
reason and at least one of message (regex on the console text) or source (regex on
the script/resource URL that logged it); every given regex must match. Keep it to
third-party noise the charity cannot fix - never the site's own code.
ci.ignoreWorkflowPaths: workflow paths (regex) excluded from the CI-green row, each with
a reason. Every other active workflow's latest default-branch run must be green.
axe: WCAG tags scanned and the impact levels that FAIL the accessibility row.

ignoreWorkflowPaths.reason: Dependabot version-update jobs: a failed dependency bump is a bot task, not the site build.
Copilot code-review agent sessions, not the repo pipeline.
